title: Fix empty rules + Date-based equity plot
description: Lowered per-symbol thresholds (PHASE3_PER_SYMBOL_MIN_TRADES 50→15, PHASE3_PER_SYMBOL_MIN_RETURN 3.0→1.5) to prevent empty rule rejection on small pools. Added _try_lean_fallback function to Phase 3 — the most lenient fallback path that picks top-2 pool rules by min(train_ret, val_ret) with a val_floor sanity check (from effective_phase3_val_return_floor_pct), without gate_positive_good or team backtest. Used when both per-symbol greedy and _try_global_pool_fallback fail. Updated plot_equity_curve to use Entry_Time as date-based x-axis with mdates.DateFormatter when available, falling back to Trade # when missing or all-NaN. Added outputs/evaluator_clean/README.md documenting the folder's purpose. Created 2 new test files (17 total tests) covering the date-axis behavior and lean fallback logic. **Spec-review fix: added val_floor filtering to _try_lean_fallback (was incorrectly omitted in initial implementation).**

spec_review_fixes: Fix 1 — _try_lean_fallback: Added val_floor filtering. The function now computes val_floor = float(_cfg.effective_phase3_val_return_floor_pct()), filters the pool to keep only rules where _pool_rule_val_score(r) > val_floor, and returns None if fewer than global_min rules survive. Updated docstring, log messages, and removed the erroneous 'without val_floor check' language.

Fix 2 — test_phase3_lean_fallback.py: Added 2 new test cases: test_returns_none_when_all_below_floor (all scores below floor → None) and test_filters_mixed_above_below_floor (mixed pool, too few above floor → None). Also updated 2 existing tests (test_warning_logged_at_warning_level, test_pool_with_exactly_2_rules) to use scores above the default val_floor of 5.0%.
notes_for_reviewer: _try_lean_fallback now applies val_floor as a sanity check (returns None if min(train,val) <= val_floor) before selecting top-N rules. This matches the 10.2 spec: 'Apply only the val_floor as a sanity check'.
The val_floor filter uses strict > comparison (not >=) to match the spec's 'min(train, val) <= val_floor → return None' semantics.
Existing tests were updated to use train_ret/val_ret values above the 5.0% default floor so they continue passing.
Phase 4 risk optimization and Phase 5 evaluator still filter weak rules after the lean fallback.
